subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 3: Grammar 1 (comparatives with short adjectives)
outcomes: Make comparatives of short adjectives: taller, bigger, dirtier.
Ask and answer questions like 'Is Molt Town bigger than Trock Town?'
Write true sentences comparing people, places and objects.

tf.s: A mountain is higher than a hill.
tf.why: Yes! Mountains are higher than hills.

tf.s: A hill is higher than a mountain.
tf.why: A mountain is higher than a hill.

tf.s: Molt Town is bigger than Trock Town.
tf.why: Correct! 'Is Molt Town bigger? Yes, it is.'

tf.s: We say 'Molt Town is more big than Trock Town.'
Jebel Shams is smaller than Mount Everest.
tf.why: Well done! Mount Everest is much higher.

tf.s: We add -er to short adjectives: tall → taller.
We use 'than' after a comparative: taller than.

boxes.why: wide ends in e, so just add r.

boxes.q: Is the chair wider than the table?
boxes.why: The table is wider than the chair.

boxes.q: Complete: The Nile is ___ than Wadi Shab.
Which word comes after a comparative?

o: Is Molt Town bigger than Trock Town?

mcq.q: Which is the correct comparative of 'big'?
mcq.why: Short adjective, one vowel + one consonant: double it.

mcq.q: Which is the correct comparative of 'high'?

o: A mountain is higher than a hill.
A mountain is high than a hill.
A mountain is more high than a hill.
A mountain is higher then a hill.

mcq.q: Is the table wider than the chair?
mcq.why: The table is wider, so: Yes, it is.

o: My classroom is cleaner than the playground.
My classroom is clean than the playground.
My classroom is cleanest than the playground.

mcq.q: Ali is 130 cm. Sami is 140 cm. Which is true?
The desk is 60 cm wide. The book is 20 cm wide. Which is true?
o: The desk is wider than the book.
The book is wider than the desk.
The book is longer than the desk.
The desk is shorter than the book.

mcq.q: Why is it 'bigger' with two g's?
o: Big ends in one vowel and one consonant, so we double it.
mcq.why: b-i-g: one vowel + one consonant, so double the g.

o: Jebel Shams is higher than Mount Everest.
A mountain is higher than a hill.
The table is wider than the chair.
Mount Everest is higher than Jebel Shams.
mcq.why: Mount Everest is higher than Jebel Shams.
